notes: Preservation districts sheet 1PD (Aug. 1993 print in the 2000 set). One heavy frame rule (~9-10 px) on left, top and right; the bottom edge sits just above the thick bar (~25 px) that rules off the full-width legend and title strip (rule 3; north arrow, scale bar and sheet number in the strip, outside, so no remove polygon). No arcs, no other notches, no SECTION badge. The page is turned (left and right rules drift ~30 px right top to bottom). District letters, SAN FRANCISCO BAY and the pier-head line are map. Ink under the outline: the pier-head line meeting the legend bar at x ~2905 (map ink truly touching the rule) and two 1-px nubs on the right rule (y ~580, ~3530); a lone speck ~3 px above the bottom edge at x ~2178 is inside. Each side's inner edge was measured every 5 px along the side (the dark run of the rule in a 3-px band, runs wider than the rule's median width replaced by outer edge + median width), smoothed with a +-60 px running median, and the outline set ~2.5 px inside it (README rule 1), points every ~200 px; corners where straight fits of the last 300 px of the two sides meet. Every vertex checked on full-resolution close-ups.
